move.text:
Dear partner,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We thank you for your constructive feedback and the prospect of a 14-day payment term, which we are pleased to integrate into our revised offer.

Our revised offer stands at a price of €17.10 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery DAP.

Alternatively, with delivery EXW: a price of €16.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days, delivery EXW.

To ensure the most competitive pricing, we must retain EXW terms, as DAP delivery would introduce significant additional costs. Furthermore, we kindly request a detailed delivery schedule to substantiate the proposed volume of 6,000 pieces per year. Which volume can you commit to? Which figures is that based on? Please send us the data. Please note that material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.

This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have carefully considered the competing offer you referenced and are pleased to reduce our price to €16.60 per unit to remain competitive.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL. Please note this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.
